goal: Provide a guided workflow for setting up multisig descriptor wallets across participants
Eliminate manual key derivation, descriptor construction, and tricky RPC workarounds
reviewability: Reviewable now; open objections regarding repo inclusion and scope invite feedback
agreement: Sentiment is split over whether temporary setup workarounds belong in the repository
Concept ACK because poor multisig tooling drives users to less scrutinized alternatives (BenWestgate)
Unaddressed objection: maintaining workarounds diverts effort from core wallet improvements (pseudoramdom)
Unaddressed objection: placing in contrib makes it look recommended and risks user funds (pseudoramdom)
Objection: ongoing maintenance burden for maintainers before RPCs make it obsolete (kevkevinpal)

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because it is a standalone helper script rather than core node or wallet tooling
Eases a complex manual setup flow, but functions as an optional utility rather than critical infrastructure
